constructionConventions: Every source name and raw table row is retained exactly. Expected full reasons are explicit expansions of the source shorthand, not captured evaluator output.

Unspecified type is storage except where the scenario identifies another type. PE and lock shorthand use storage.pe.approved and generic.lock.cannotdelete. DI shorthand uses storage.sku.geo. P3 shorthand uses storage.metrics.user-writes.
